summary: RFC-0062 OQ-3: routing labels from first-pass review approval; PPA labels weak-supervised from implicit outcomes with the scheduler rank logged as propensity; no explicit operator label step

options.description: Routing from review approval once taskClass is real; PPA from four implicit outcomes combined by a stated rule; shadow rows log score and rank
First-pass approval is the only label; PPA stays unfitted
Map DEC chosen options to labels

body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-3 resolution (2026-11-06). Zero labelled priority outcomes exist; routing has 1,923 review records with one taskClass. Explicit rating steps decay to zero compliance; Decision Catalog answers decide process, not priority; implicit outcomes (landed/abandoned, operator priority edits, queue age vs bucket, hold/park decisions) accrue from normal operation and the logged rank corrects for the policy that produced the log.
